content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in St. Louis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and formal project management education—no work experience needed. This makes it ideal for St. Louis professionals entering project management roles across Healthcare, Financial Services, Aerospace, and Manufacturing. Verify your degree and review the education requirement with our team.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused schedule, designed for working professionals. Classes are delivered online nationwide, fitting seamlessly around your St. Louis job.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education, apply directly to PMI with proof of your 23 contact hours. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Our team provides guidance on documentation requirements and the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy supports your exam readiness with targeted preparation resources and practice materials. Schedule your CAPM exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors—active certified practitioners—help you identify weak areas and build confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional involvement to renew. Stay current in your field and advance your career in St. Louis's competitive project management market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth pursuing for St. Louis project managers?
fq_items.answer: Yes. St. Louis's largest employers—Boeing, Bayer, BJC HealthCare, Mercy, and SSM Health—regularly list PMP or CAPM credentials as preferred or required in project manager job postings. Even where not mandatory, certification helps candidates stand out in a competitive local hiring market. The credential signals foundational PM competency and positions you for advancement, particularly in healthcare, defense, and financial services, where demand for certified professionals remains strong.

fq_items.question: Which St. Louis industries value CAPM certification most?
fq_items.answer: Healthcare, aerospace and defense, and financial services are St. Louis's strongest sectors for certified project managers. Major employers like BJC HealthCare, Mercy, SSM Health, Boeing, and Edward Jones actively seek professionals with project management credentials. Biotech, manufacturing, and logistics roles also increasingly favor or require CAPM or PMP certification. Earning your CAPM early improves your profile in any of these high-demand fields.
